hitLocation.note: Rolled only for a declared location attack. Aim (1 extra action) shifts the d20 result by up to ±5.

locationAttack.note: Declared before rolling: −4 TN. On a hit, roll the location and damage. Damage minus armor comes off HP as usual. If damage gets through the armor, the location adds its condition; if the armor stops it completely, the armor cracks by 1 (repairable). Cover never cracks.

injuries.note: Condition added when a location attack gets through the armor. head: Incapacitated instead when the hit leaves the target at half HP or less.

falling.note: Decision 272: up to `free` metres a fall costs nothing but a landing roll; beyond that a d`die` per full `per` metres (a floor is about 3 m), at most `max` dice. Landing: `skill` halves it (rounded down); a failure leaves you Prone; a natural 20 cripples a leg. Then armor applies, never cover.

breath.note: Decision 273: holding your breath lasts CON rounds (half, rounded down, when caught by surprise; at least 1). Then a CON roll each round at −`step` more every round; a failure: Incapacitated. Out with no air: `drown` a round, straight off HP. Air back: you come round. A round passes at the start of your turn in a fight, or by hand out of one.
